lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active customer adoption and portfolio updates in EFB, flight planning, and crew solutions, with vendor-specific wins recorded for Aviobook, IFS, Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, and Navblue.

insights.title: Aviobook secures Royal Air Maroc for AvioBook Flight EFB
insights.finding: Thales (Aviobook) signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service carrier.
insights.caveat: Five-year term and deployment specifics depend on contractual execution.

insights.title: IFS captures multiple carrier wins for IFS EFBOne
insights.finding: IFS secured customer deployments and selections for its IFS EFBOne platform with fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) are classified as low-cost carriers (LCCs); TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure/uncertain carrier.
insights.caveat: Captures show selections and deployments; full fleet rollout timelines vary.

insights.title: Jeppesen expands airline dispatch and flight planning agreements
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured major flight planning and dispatch agreements with Korean Air (for its integrated fleet) and Corendon Airlines as a launch customer for Dispatch v2026-2.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air is a major full-service carrier, while Corendon Airlines operates as a leisure/charter carrier.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect initial agreements and launch milestones.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems expands Lido Flight 4D deployments
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and deployed Lido mPilot for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a full-service carrier, and Viva operates as a carrier brand.
insights.caveat: Deployment notices indicate active implementation milestones.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems corporate restructuring exploration
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems reportedly explored a potential sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine are core software product suites for flight planning, navigation, and crew management.
insights.caveat: Reports are based on financial media coverage and do not confirm a finalized transaction.
